scope: Completed 24500 inference only; 0/+/-.5m/s, N4 per case, 20s; no PPO or high-speed/full-DR claim

formulas.history: Actual sent actions, zero at birth, retained across phases; raw/clip differ only at native action bounds, including next two history rows
formulas.effort_density: -1e-4*(sum(actual applied torque6^2)+sum positive(actual wheel torque*dq)); last 200Hz substep before each 50Hz reward
formulas.reward_payment: densities * policy_dt(.02); effort values reconstruct these two components, not full logged reward or a learned counterfactual
formulas.scut_projection: source root_lin_vel_b.x*cos(Euler pitch); no SCUT physical trace evaluated
formulas.equivalence: For unit gravity and standard Euler pitch: gx=sin(pitch), sqrt(1-gx^2)=abs(cos(pitch)); normal canonical Euler pitch matches
formulas.heading_caveat: Not full inverse heading velocity; pure horizontal world motion at zero roll/yaw gives projected vx=world vx*cos(pitch)^2
formulas.velocity_origin_caveat: Ours pins base_link_origin. SCUT calls classic root_lin_vel_b; saved run lacks SDK identity to authenticate its historical velocity origin
